products.name: Ashgrove House Blend
products.short: Brazil and Guatemala, medium. Chocolate, hazelnut, brown sugar.
products.desc: The coffee we drink at the roastery all day. Sweet and round, with enough body for milk and enough clarity to drink black. It is the bag most people reorder first.

products.name: Morning Fog
products.short: Colombia, Huila, washed. Red apple, caramel, clean finish.
products.origin: Colombia, Huila. Finca El Roble, 1,750 m.
products.desc: A bright, easy morning coffee. We roast it a touch past first crack so the apple shows up without any sourness, and the caramel carries through a cup that has gone cold on the desk.

products.name: Summit
products.short: Ethiopia, Guji, natural. Blueberry, jasmine, honey.
products.origin: Ethiopia, Guji zone. Smallholder lots, 2,100 m.
products.desc: Our lightest roast and the one that surprises people. Fruity and floral as a pour-over, sweet as it cools. Not for the espresso machine.

products.name: Hollow Oak
products.short: Brazil, Colombia, India. Dark cocoa, toffee, long body.
products.origin: Brazil, Colombia and India, roasted together.
products.desc: Built for espresso and milk drinks: thick crema, cocoa and toffee, and a finish that holds up in a flat white. Works in a moka pot too.

products.name: Night Market
products.short: Sumatra and Brazil. Smoke, molasses, cedar.
products.card: Sumatra and Brazil. Smoke, molasses, cedar.
products.desc: For people who like their coffee dark without tasting burnt. Heavy, low acid and smoky, with a sweet molasses finish.

products.name: Ember Decaf
products.short: Colombia, sugarcane process. Cocoa, dried fig.
products.card: Colombia, sugarcane process. Cocoa, dried fig.
products.desc: Decaffeinated with a natural sugarcane process, so it still tastes like coffee. Good after dinner, good for a second cup.

products.name: Ceramic pour-over dripper
products.short: Stoneware, 1 to 2 cups, glazed in cream.
products.card: Stoneware, 1 to 2 cups, glazed in cream.
products.desc: A heavy stoneware dripper that holds heat well and fits most mugs. Takes standard cone filters.

products.name: Paper filters, 100
products.desc: One hundred unbleached cone filters. Rinse once with hot water before brewing.

products.name: Hand grinder
products.desc: Conical steel burrs with 40 click settings, from espresso to French press. Grinds a pour-over dose in about forty turns.

products.name: Enamel camp mug
products.desc: A 12 oz mug with the lantern mark on the side. Light, hard to break, fine in the dishwasher.

products.name: Stoneware cup set, 2
products.short: Two small cups, glazed by a local potter.
products.card: Two small cups, glazed by a local potter.
products.desc: Two 6 oz cups for espresso or a short pour-over, made for us by a potter down the road (fictional).

products.name: Roaster's choice, monthly
products.short: Two bags a month, we pick, skip any time.
products.card: Two bags a month, we pick, skip any time.
products.desc: Two 12 oz bags a month, picked by Mara and Tomas from that week's roasts. In this demo it is a single product: real recurring billing needs the paid WooCommerce Subscriptions extension, so nothing renews.
